job.title: Home Chef
job.description:
We are hiring a Home Chef for a household in Wuye, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role with accommodation and weekly days off.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and cook daily meals for the household to a consistently high standard.
  • Prepare dishes to suit the household's tastes and any dietary needs.
  • Plan weekly menus and portions, and suggest new dishes.
  • Keep the kitchen clean and follow food safety and hygiene standards.
  • Monitor kitchen stock, buy or request groceries and keep waste low.

Requirements

  • Certificate from a culinary school
  • At least 2 years' experience as a chef
  • Good communication skills
  • Presentable and able to work with little to no supervision
  • Able to work in Wuye, Abuja and resume immediately
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Accommodation.
  • Weekly days off.

job.title: Paid Internship Programme
job.description:
We are hiring corps members and graduates for a paid internship programme with our client in the real estate sector in Lagos (Ibeju-Lekki) and Abuja. No experience needed. Selected candidates will be trained for 6 to 12 months.

Responsibilities

  • Join a paid internship programme with our client in the real estate sector in Lagos (Ibeju Lekki) and Abuja.
  • Be trained for 6 to 12 months, learning how the business works from the people who run it.
  • Support the team with day-to-day tasks as you learn.
  • No experience is needed: selected candidates are trained from the start.

Requirements

  • A serving corps member or a graduate of a Nigerian university
  • No previous experience needed
  • Good communication skills and a willingness to learn
  • Able to work full time in Lagos (Ibeju Lekki) and/or Abuja
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Paid internship.
  • 6 to 12 months of training.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
We are hiring an Accountant in Gwarimpa, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role for an experienced accountant with 5 to 8 years' experience.

Responsibilities

  • Keep accurate books of account and prepare regular ledger and bank reconciliations.
  • Prepare and file tax and other statutory returns on time.
  • Prepare monthly financial reports for management.

Requirements

  • B.Sc or HND in Accounting, Finance or a related field
  • ICAN or ACCA (certified or part-qualified)
  • 5 to 8 Years' Experience in Accounting
  • Knowledge of Nigerian tax rules
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Professional development support.
  • Performance bonus.
  • Other statutory benefits.
